Students should note the following USC degree requirements for the WBB program:

- A minimum of 32 units must be taken in residence at USC.

notes.text: The World Bachelor in Business (WBB) Program offers students the opportunity for immersive study at three highly regarded business schools, one in each of the major economic/cultural zones of the world: the Americas, Asia and Europe. The program is designed and offered in cooperation with the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) and Bocconi University. Students spend at least one year at each campus and receive a degree from each university. The program is available to entering freshmen only. Prospective students should consult with the USC Marshall Undergraduate Admissions office for program and admissions information.
notes.source_line: The World Bachelor in Business (WBB) Program offers students the opportunity for immersive study at three highly regarded business schools, one in each of the major economic/cultural zones of the world: the Americas, Asia and Europe. The program is designed and offered in cooperation with the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) and Bocconi University. Students spend at least one year at each campus and receive a degree from each university. The program is available to entering freshmen only. Prospective students should consult with the USC Marshall Undergraduate Admissions office for program and admissions information.

notes.text: Specific courses completed at each university are used to fulfill specific requirements at the other universities. To successfully move through the curriculum, which includes the ability to begin coursework at partner institutions, and graduate (obtain all three degrees/diplomas), students must satisfy the academic standards and policies of all partner institutions and successfully complete the required coursework each term.

notes.text: A minimum of 32 units must be taken in residence at USC. The units applied toward this requirement must be taken for a letter grade and cannot be taken on a P/NP or CR/NC basis.
notes.source_line: - A minimum of 32 units must be taken in residence at USC. The units applied toward this requirement must be taken for a letter grade and cannot be taken on a P/NP or CR/NC basis.

notes.text: In addition to meeting university GPA requirements, a minimum grade of C- must be earned on all upper-division course work taken at USC and required for the major.
notes.source_line: - In addition to meeting university GPA requirements, a minimum grade of C- must be earned on all upper-division course work taken at USC and required for the major.

notes.text: A minimum grade of C- for course work completed at HKUST and Bocconi University must be earned for the course credits to transfer to USC.
notes.source_line: - A minimum grade of C- for course work completed at HKUST and Bocconi University must be earned for the course credits to transfer to USC.

notes.text: USC GPA calculations will be based on course work completed at USC.
notes.source_line: - USC GPA calculations will be based on course work completed at USC.

notes.text: WBB students spend the first year taking classes in Los Angeles at USC, the second year taking classes in Hong Kong at HKUST and the third year taking classes in Milan at Bocconi University. In the final year, students choose their location of study in consultation with the program directors. Each year includes at least one cohort class designed specifically for the WBB program.

Students will meet with a WBB program academic adviser at each location to ensure that each student’s program of study will fulfill WBB program requirements.
